interpretation: Shorter context produced usable JSON once, but several factual premises remain wrong. No general compression/reliability or ML-quality improvement is established. Preserve numeric evaluation and qualification outside the LLM.
harness_limitations: The card formatter omitted an explicit complete-agent unit/control ID and metric direction from MVP cards. The prompt asked to distinguish units but did not map each MVP card explicitly. Do not attribute all errors solely to the model.

After this call, the formatter was changed to emit COMPLETE_AGENT, direction, oriented gain and mean-improved boolean from code; five no-fit checks pass. No further API call has measured the effect of that repair.
